name: Box
scope_notes: Do not substitute Box Shield location/anomaly detection or corporate firewall allowlisting for API source-IP enforcement.

controls.name: Admin authorization of server authentication apps
controls.what: JWT, CCG and Limited Access (App Token) apps cannot be used in the enterprise until an admin authorizes them by Client ID.
controls.setting: Admin Console > Platform > Platform Apps > Server Authentication Apps
controls.quote: authorize and enable custom server authentication apps, such as JSON Web Token (JWT) apps, client credential apps, and limited access apps,

controls.name: Re-authorization on scope/access changes
controls.what: Authorization is a snapshot; changed scopes or access level need admin re-authorization.
controls.setting: Admin Console > Platform > Platform Apps > … > Reauthorize
controls.quote: The authorization is a snapshot in time. This means that if a developer revisits the Developer Console and changes the configuration, the Admin must re-authorize the application in order for generated Access Tokens to reflect the changes.

controls.name: Disable unpublished platform apps by default
controls.what: Unpublished custom apps (OAuth and server-auth) are disabled until an admin enables them.
controls.setting: Admin Console > Enterprise Settings > Platform Apps
controls.quote: When you select Disable unpublished platform apps by default, Box disables all unpublished platform apps by default.

controls.name: Enable/disable user authentication app
controls.what: Admins enable or disable a custom OAuth 2.0 app for the enterprise by Client ID.
controls.setting: Admin Console > Platform > Platform Apps > User Authentication Apps
controls.quote: enable custom user authentication applications, such as OAuth 2.0 apps, and

controls.name: Integration Availability Status
controls.what: Disables a published integration for all or selected users; existing installs stop working.
controls.quote: If you disable an application on this page, account holders are unable to add the application to their Box accounts, and cannot use the application if the account holder previously installed it.

controls.name: Enable Integrations by default
controls.what: Toggling off disables all published integrations by default.
controls.quote: Integrations are enabled by default. When you toggle off Enable Integrations by default, Box disables all Integrations.
